SELECT g.transaction_account_id, g.region_name, g.group_sum, g.group_row_count, g.group_sum / o.overall_sum AS quotient
FROM (
  SELECT t.account_id AS transaction_account_id, d.A3 AS region_name,
         SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount
                  WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN 0 - t.amount
                  ELSE NULL END) AS group_sum,
         COUNT(*) AS group_row_count
  FROM trans AS t
  JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
  JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
  GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3
) AS g
JOIN (
  SELECT SUM(group_sum) AS overall_sum
  FROM (
    SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount
                    WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN 0 - t.amount
                    ELSE NULL END) AS group_sum
    FROM trans AS t
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3
  )
) AS o ON o.overall_sum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY quotient DESC
LIMIT 10.
